test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In each of the following questions, a statement is given followed by 2 conclusions.Read the statements carefully and answer the following questions:

Statements:

(i) All staff members who attended the seminar found it beneficial.

(ii) Ms. Chen is a staff member.

Conclusions:

(i) Ms. Chen found the seminar beneficial.

(ii) No one who missed the seminar found it beneficial.
solution:
Given Statements:

(i) All staff members who attended the seminar found it beneficial.

(ii) Ms. Chen is a staff member.

Conclusions:

(i) Ms. Chen found the seminar beneficial - Does not follow (Because it is not given that Ms. Chen attended the seminar.)

(ii) No one who missed the seminar found it beneficial - Does not follow (The statement does not mention anything about people who missed the seminar.)

So, Neither conclusion (i) nor (ii) follows..

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
